objective: Descriptively compare baseline P0+S0 against hardened P1+S2 under mandatory authoritative structured_output on two independently referenced holdouts.

H1.kind: translation-origin controlled mutations plus independent clean controls from other origins

response_rule: Presence, JSON type, and for strings UTF-8 byte length/hash only; never parse, normalize, compare, project, score, or use as fallback.
continue_rule: Continue after a strict payload with zero candidates or any quote/span membership failure.
stop_rule: Stop later calls after route/process/network/eligibility failure, malformed or duplicate-key outer JSON, missing/invalid structured_output, strict payload failure, ledger inconsistency, artifact collision, static drift, or sealing/private-cwd violation.

adoption_gate.mechanical: Every hardened candidate-bearing run has 100% exact quote and target-span membership.
adoption_gate.effectiveness: For each dataset, in at least two of three repetition pairs, hardened has at most one additional missed reference defect and at most one additional clean-item false positive versus baseline.

headline_rule: H1 and H2 are reported separately; no pooled headline metric. Union and consensus are descriptive derived summaries, not measured single runs.

uniform_rendering_contract.predecessor_deviations: Pretty-printing and terminal LF are deliberately not retained. Compact serialization and no trailing LF apply identically to every condition, removing them as between-condition confounds.
